purpose: Bootstrap manifest for the private meids-agent-configs repository without exposing secrets, private webhook URLs, credentials, or private knowledge.

top_level_agents.approval_boundary: Answer-only requests can complete without approval. External actions must be routed through Agentic Butler and human approval gates.

top_level_agents.role: Ingest, curate, audit, and route OKF knowledge fabric updates.
top_level_agents.approval_boundary: May create pending-review OKF concepts and candidate graph edges. Must not promote trusted knowledge or refresh trusted vector indexes without review policy approval.

top_level_agents.role: Work execution agent for approved skills with the Skill Orchestrator as an internal component.
top_level_agents.approval_boundary: May activate approved skills and create draft work products. Must pause before sending emails, creating meetings, committing externally, or any action marked requires_human.

copy_plan.action: Copy public fixture contracts into contracts/n8n as baseline contracts.
Add n8n workflow exports under workflows/n8n after reviewing them for secrets.
Add agent prompts and skill orchestration policies under prompts and skills.
Configure public UAT URLs or private hosted backend secrets outside Git.
Run fixture replay, live probes, UAT, and human approval gates before merging to main.

non_goals: No live webhook URLs in this manifest.
No private knowledge payloads in this manifest.
No API keys, bearer tokens, Azure keys, or n8n credentials in this manifest.
No approval bypass for generated or refined skills.
readiness_requirements: All three top-level agent fixtures validate locally.
All three top-level agent workflows return the envelope shape from their fixtures.
Approval-required fixture cases pause and emit human approval requests.
Failure fixture cases return structured recoverable errors.
The cockpit records trace IDs for live probes.
Knowledge Fabric Agent keeps unapproved knowledge in pending-review state.
Agentic Butler keeps Skill Orchestrator internal.
